sections.title: Use of Proceeds
sections.excerpt:
Use of proceeds We estimate that the net proceeds to us from this offering will be approximately $145.0 million (or approximately $166.8 million if the underwriters’ over-allotment option is exercised in full), after deducting the
underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated offering expenses payable by us. We currently intend to use the net proceeds from this offering, and, if consummated, the concurrent equity offering and, if it is consummated, the concurrent private placement, primarily to fund our ongoing and planned clinical
trials advancing RAP-219, for other research and development, and for working capital and general corporate purposes. See the caption “Use of Proceeds” for additional information.
